description: Fit scoring for a first international role combining RTPI-accredited UK spatial planning with PropTech/AI compliance-tooling experience. No LLM needed — deterministic keyword model used by notify.py's weekly digest and instant-alert fallback.

fit_terms.pattern: \bplanning technolog(?:y|ist)\b|\bproptech\b|\bprop-tech\b|\bprop tech\b|\bproperty technology\b|\bplanning software\b|\breal estate technology\b|\breal estate saas\b|\bconstruction technology\b|\bcontech\b|\bbuildtech\b

poor_fit_terms.pattern: \bsales executive\b|\bestate agent\b|\bletting agent\b|\blettings negotiator\b|\bbusiness development manager\b

test_cases.title: Graduate Planning Technology Consultant
test_cases.description: RTPI-accredited graduate role combining UK planning policy research with AI-powered compliance and planning-data products. Interpret planning applications and Approved Document B requirements, translate them into structured digital workflows, and support clients configuring the platform. Uses GIS/spatial data and works closely with the product team.
test_cases.rationale: Exact target profile: RTPI planning knowledge plus AI/PropTech product work, matching both independent projects on the CV.

test_cases.title: Graduate Town Planner
test_cases.description: RTPI-accredited graduate programme covering development management, planning applications, infrastructure planning and client advice across a range of projects.
test_cases.rationale: Strong core-planning match and the right seniority, but no PropTech/AI/technology angle, so it stays below the gold-standard combined role.

test_cases.title: Solutions Consultant
test_cases.description: Configure the platform for new enterprise clients, gather requirements, run onboarding calls, and coordinate with the product team.
test_cases.rationale: Generic client-facing tech role with real overlap to the 'solutions consultant' signal, but no planning/spatial/built-environment domain content, so it should not score as a standout.

test_cases.title: Site Engineer
test_cases.description: On-site engineering role reviewing drawings, managing subcontractors, and overseeing groundworks and structural installation.
test_cases.rationale: Overlaps with the civil-engineering degree but is exactly the hands-on construction track the candidate is moving away from; explicitly penalized down to (or near) zero.

test_cases.title: Software Engineer
test_cases.description: Build and maintain backend services in a microservices architecture; no built-environment or planning domain.
test_cases.rationale: Pure software engineering with no planning/PropTech domain content should not surface as a match even though the candidate has some AI-tooling experience.
